groups.saying_opens: لا يزال هذا الدين عزيزا إلى

notes: Two sayings: the Prophet's «لا يزال هذا الدين» with its isnad (group 1), and the answer «كلهم من قريش» which the report gives after a first-person question (group 2; rule 4a).
Needs ruling (rule 11): the head of the second saying is an unnamed first-person speaker («قلت لأبي»); «أبي» is a bare relation, not identified.
